title: Copyright Act 2023: Digital Piracy & Remedies in Bangladesh
metaTitle: Copyright Act 2023: Digital Piracy Remedies in BD
metaDescription: Protect software, YouTube videos, books, and digital content under the Copyright Act 2023 in Bangladesh. Learn registration, civil injunctions, and penalties.
heroIntro: Bangladesh's Copyright Act 2023 (কপিরাইট আইন, ২০২৩) replaced the 2000 Act to modernize protection for software, digital content, YouTube/streaming media, AI-assisted databases, literary works, and cinematograph films. Creators and businesses can enforce rights through Copyright Office registration, District Judge civil injunctions, and criminal prosecution carrying up to 4 years' imprisonment.

quickAnswer.heading: At a Glance: Copyright Act 2023 Protection
quickAnswer.text: Copyright exists automatically upon creation, while registration provides prima facie proof in court.
points: Governing Statute: The Copyright Act 2023 (Act No. 34 of 2023) & Copyright Rules
Protection Term: Author's lifetime + 60 years for literary/artistic/musical works; 60 years for films/software
Civil Remedies: Injunction, damages, and delivery-up of infringing copies before the District Judge
Criminal Penalties: Up to 4 years imprisonment and BDT 200,000–500,000 fine (enhanced for software piracy)

sections.h2: Key Reforms Introduced by the Copyright Act 2023
sections.content: Enacted in September 2023, the Copyright Act 2023 expands statutory protection beyond print and broadcast to cover digital platforms, cloud software, OTT streaming, databases, and folkloric/cultural expressions. It also introduces stronger anti-circumvention rules against bypassing Digital Rights Management (DRM) locks and clarifies intermediary safe-harbor and notice-and-takedown duties.

sections.h2: What Works Are Protected & How to Register at the Copyright Office
sections.content:
Under the Copyright Act 2023, protection covers original literary works (including computer programs and source code), dramatic, musical, and artistic works, cinematograph films, sound recordings, and broadcasts. While copyright arises automatically upon fixation, registering with the Bangladesh Copyright Office (Agargaon, Dhaka) creates a statutory certificate that serves as prima facie evidence of ownership in court.

  • Submit Form-IV/application via the Copyright Office e-portal with two copies of the work.
  • Publish statutory notice/wait period for objections (typically 30 days for artistic/literary works).
  • Obtain the official Registration Certificate for enforcement and licensing.

sections.h2: Civil Remedies: Injunction, Damages & Anton Piller Orders
sections.content:
When a competitor copies your software, course material, e-commerce product photography, or digital video, the copyright owner may file a civil suit in the Court of the District Judge having jurisdiction where the owner resides or carries on business. Available reliefs include:

  • Temporary & Permanent Injunction under Order 39 Rules 1–2 CPC to halt ongoing distribution;
  • Account of Profits or Compensatory Damages for lost licensing revenue; and
  • Inspection & Seizure Orders to preserve digital servers, hard drives, and pirated stock before destruction.

Knowingly infringing copyright for commercial gain is a cognizable offense under the Copyright Act 2023. Penalties range up to 4 years imprisonment and BDT 200,000 fine for general works, and up to 4 years imprisonment and BDT 500,000 fine for commercial software piracy. For online content theft on YouTube, Facebook, or websites, a lawyer-issued DMCA / Copyright Takedown Notice backed by a Bangladesh Copyright Registration Certificate accelerates platform removal.

sections.h2: Checklist Before Filing a Copyright Infringement Suit
sections.content:
• Bangladesh Copyright Registration Certificate or dated source-code/manuscript creation logs.
  • Timestamped screenshots, URLs, SHA-256 hashes, or notarized captures of the infringing content.
  • Formal Cease and Desist Legal Notice served on the infringer (and hosting/platform intermediary).
  • Evidence of commercial loss, licensing rate, or reputational harm.

faqs.q: Is copyright registration mandatory to sue for infringement in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: No, copyright subsists automatically upon creation. However, a Certificate of Registration from the Bangladesh Copyright Office acts as prima facie proof of ownership and makes injunctions and criminal complaints significantly faster.

faqs.q: Does the Copyright Act 2023 protect mobile apps and SaaS source code?
faqs.a: Yes. Computer programs, source code, UI compilations, and databases are explicitly protected as literary works under the Copyright Act 2023, with enhanced criminal fines for commercial software piracy.

faqs.q: Can a foreign company enforce copyright in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Yes. Under the Berne Convention and international copyright reciprocity rules incorporated into Bangladesh law, works created in Berne/WTO member countries enjoy reciprocal protection in Bangladesh.
